title: Add JSONSchema 'strict' response_format with OpenAI-compat error reporting
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a new strict JSONSchema response_format mode for structured output that enforces schema conformance at the API boundary and surfaces OpenAI-compatible error objects when validation fails. Motivation: customers who use structured outputs and function/tool-calling need deterministic, machine-readable failure modes to recover gracefully; existing response_format validation returned internal error strings that were hard to map to OpenAI-compat clients. This PR implements a strict validation path that: 1) validates model output against user-provided JSONSchema after post-processing; 2) when validation fails in strict mode, returns a structured error payload following OpenAI's recommended error fields (type, message, param, code) plus a compact validation summary; 3) adds a heuristics-backed recovery hint field (suggested_fix) that can be used by client SDKs to auto-retry with clarifications or relax strictness; 4) keeps the permissive/legacy response_format behavior unchanged unless strict=true. The change touches runtime validation (service/api/response_format), OpenAI-compat layer (service/api/openai_compat), SDK helpers (sdk/python/redwood/response_format.py and redwood-sdk-typescript), extensive unit/integration tests, and docs. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to canary users, telemetry for validation failure rates and client-side autocorrect attempts, and automatic gradual enablement for accounts that opt-in. See linked Linear tickets for rollout milestones.

merge_summary: Squash-merged jsonschema strict-mode with OpenAI-compatible error reporting and SDK helpers; docs and tests included.
release_notes: Add response_format strict mode: validates outputs against user JSONSchema and returns OpenAI-compatible structured errors on validation failures. Includes SDK helpers and migration notes in docs.
backport_notes: Backport to release/1.28 required for enterprise customers using dedicated; change is behind feature flag but backport recommended. See ENG-1423 for schedule.
observability_notes: New telemetry events: validation.failure.count, validation.failure.reason, validation.recovery.attempts. Dashboards added under 'Structured Output -> JSONSchema strict'.
security_implications: No new data plane permissions. Error payload includes a truncated snippet of the invalid response (max 512 chars) configurable by org policy to avoid leaking sensitive content.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover 88% of validator code paths; integration tests exercise function-calling and SDK recovery flows; small benchmark shows 4-6% CPU overhead on worst-case payloads. E2E test added for permissive fallback flow.
notes: Feature gated behind feature flag jsonschema.strict; enabled for internal canary and opt-in customers only. Monitor validation.failure.rate and client autocorrect success rate during rollout.
